about: Recipes: for a failure class that keeps coming back (the finding log, lib/findingRepeats.js), what would guard it in this stack. One recipe per class and stack; the first whose `when` holds is shown on the card ledger-recipes. `when` uses the conditions of the cards (lib/checksCatalog.js, plugin/docs/checks.md), `cards` names cards that already do the work, and `examples` are facts the recipe must hold for (hit) and must not hold for (miss); a test checks them. A project adds, replaces (same id) or removes (`off: true`) a recipe in docs/queue/checks/recipes.json. The database recipes (access control, migration and schema) come with the database probes.

recipes.title: A lint rule for results nobody checks
recipes.text: Turn on @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises (and no-misused-promises) in the project's eslint setup, or a no-restricted-syntax rule for the exact call that was left unchecked, and run lint in gates.quick.

recipes.title: A lint rule and a test on the error path
recipes.text: A no-restricted-syntax rule in the project's eslint setup for the call whose result was left unchecked (or eslint-plugin-promise catch-or-return), and a test that makes that call fail and expects the error to reach the caller.

recipes.title: Ruff rules for swallowed errors, or a test on the error path
recipes.text: Ruff rules for swallowed errors (BLE001 blind except, S110 try-except-pass, E722 bare except) in the project's ruff setup, or a pytest test that makes the failing call raise and expects the error to reach the caller.

recipes.title: A type check in the gates and CI
recipes.text: A type check in gates.quick and CI: tsc --noEmit for TypeScript, mypy or pyright for Python, with a mild setting and a baseline for the errors there are today.

recipes.title: The type check in CI too
recipes.text: The type check runs, but not in CI: add it to the CI workflow, so a change that skips the local gates is caught too.

recipes.title: A secret scan in CI
recipes.text: gitleaks (or trufflehog) in CI on every push, with an allow list where each entry says why it is safe.

recipes.title: A narrower allow list for the scan
recipes.text: The scan runs in CI but this one got past it: check the allow list (every entry needs a reason), and add the file kind or folder it missed to the scan's paths.

recipes.title: Time limits and a worker cap for the tests
recipes.text: A time limit per test above the default and a cap on the workers (vitest or jest --maxWorkers) in the gate command, so parallel tracks on one machine do not starve each other. A weakened test: restore it, and keep testWeakening.enabled on.

recipes.title: Time limits and a worker cap for pytest
recipes.text: pytest-timeout with a time limit per test, and a cap on pytest-xdist workers (-n 2 rather than -n auto) in the gate command. A weakened test: restore it, and keep testWeakening.enabled on.
